description: The new wallet proves itself: first call returns a challenge for it, second call with wallet_proof {message, signature} adds it. It belongs to your company and you operate it. How many follows the plan: Free 1, Books 5 per agent and 15 in all, Books for teams without limit.

address.description: The wallet to add, 0x followed by 40 hex characters

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

provider.description: Optional: what holds the key: awal, cdp, viem or other

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one

wallet_proof.description: Second call only: the challenge message the first call returned, and the signature of that wallet over it

name: lounge.wallet.add
title: Add a wallet
